title: Courtney Shoe v. Curd and acknowledgment language
shortTitle: Courtney Shoe v. Curd and acknowledgment language
summary: A statement acknowledging an order may have a different meaning from a statement accepting it.
notes: The comparison asks what the correspondence communicates and contrasts language merely promising attention with the letter in International Filter. The label “acknowledgment” does not determine the legal effect.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 220–221. Open assigned page 220.
